item.title: Adrenaline Raceway: TLR Typhon Race Prep Series Episode 7 [VIDEO]
item.description: Check out some indoor track laps with Jacob Hardison in episode 7 of the TLR Typhon Race Prep Series at Adrenaline Raceway.

item.title: Setting Ride Height With The Drake [VIDEO]
item.description: Adam Drake took some time this week to get back to the fundamentals and show how he sets ride height.

item.title: Hobbywing XR10 Legacy Run Through With Spencer Rivkin [VIDEO]
item.description: Check out Spencer Rivkin's take on the new HOBBYWING Legacy ESC. A cost effective race ready ESC with lots of great features and an amazing price point.

item.title: Ongaro Joins Team EAM
item.description: Team EAM, Inc proudly welcomes one of the most dominant drivers in RC racing history: Davide Ongaro from Italy.

item.title: New Willspeed B7 Fast Fox Conversion
item.description: Willspeed is ready to release their new Fast Fox B7 Cantilever suspension conversion.

item.title: Haatanen and Hot Race Part Ways
item.description: Going into 2026 Joona Haatanen will no longer be racing for Hot Race.

item.title: Sontag Joins J&T Bearing Co.
item.description: Tater Sontag will be using the full line of J&T accessories and Pro Motion products going into 2026.

item.title: New Avid RC Hard Anodized 7 Series Aluminum Slipper Screw
item.description: The Avid RC Associated B7 / T7 / SC7 slipper screw is now hard-anodized 7075-T6 aluminum and weighs just 1.43g.

item.title: New Avid RC -2 Degree 3-Gear AE C-Mount
item.description: These Avid RC C-mounts for the B7/T7/SC7 and B84 free up the vehicle in the turns and when landing jumps sideways such as corner tabletops.

item.title: Neumann Announces Sworkz Departure
item.description: Jorn Neumann announced today via social media that he will no longer be running for Sworkz going into 2026.
